entry_points.text: Entry checks permission and enlightened, syncs VMCS12, rejects SS-block, launch mismatch, bad controls, addr mismatch; pages need enlightened and VMCS12 load; pump orders init, faults, trap, timer, SMI, NMI, IRQ with blocking and morphing.

VMXON validates and enters, VMXOFF releases; CLEAR and PTRLD validate with revision; PTRST stores; READ and WRITE emulate; LAUNCH and RESUME delegate; INVEPT and INVVPID decode, fetch, validate, flush and succeed.
Query probes size and fills header and images by mode; restore validates format, region, feature, SMM, deadline before rebuilding and entering.
PMU reads serve control, counters, selectors, LBR; writes reject reserved, reprogram on change, handle widths, delegate LBR, else unhandled.

exports.text: Decode VMX mem operand from qualification and instr info to validated guest VA, rejecting regs; strip LAM tags per mode and privilege, preserving class.
L1 guest VA write flushes L1 cache then page-writes with fault or IO-needed result; vendor ops centralize leave, GPA translate, event, triple, save/restore and enlightened hooks.

hazards.text: Invalidate sharing base; HW qualif for HW only; flush entry; no reread in migrate; missing to IO; fresh VPID flush; decode checks form, canonical, segs, limits, class; trunc avoids fail; CLEAR ignores, PTRLD mismatch, READ compat, masked; ABI: EPT 51:12, failure, entry, activity, MP, exit, IRQ, qualif, 256 vec, -1 none, prio, debug, emu err, scale, sizes, reg, seg, trunc, write, flat, LAM, 5L, rev, sentinel, page, launch, VMX err, lock, en, shadow, EPT, VPID, w-any, caps, ext, vec, roots.

Missing mode, paging or version warns with fallback; bad LBR reads zero and absorbs; copy faults fail and bad restores abort with run cleared; uses bit, bug, min, nospec, perf, irq, user-copy helpers.

invariants.text: EPT root matches only if host root valid and masked bases equal; invalidate scans prior roots and faults matching subset in nested GPA walker.
Page-fault intercept XORs low-16 error mismatch with bitmap; others follow bitmap; MSR intercept ORs host and L1 per direction; ext fields cover segs, tables, debug, bound.
Shadow VMCS12 caches only when enabled with valid link, remapping on change; 64-bit host needs exit-bitness match; enlightened VMCLEAR releases only on address equality.

Exception picks qualif by payload, addr or debug with truncated error and NMI-unblock; posted folds bitmap to vAPIC; top vector or -1; VMPTR decodes and reads; triple exits; debug pending only for debug vector; timer needs enable plus expired; poll and blocking order init, startup, trap, timer, SMI, NMI, IRQ.

Rare sync only when flagged and primary loaded; shadow alloc only if absent and primary loaded; VMXON orders enable, priv, active, control, operand, revision; pointers must be valid paged, not activation, with revision and shadow checks; VM ops share instr-info decode; shadow uses RW/RO lists with rare-sync, rights mask, mirror, dirty, relaxed under write-any; invalidation support from caps with pointer, ID, canonical checks; guest writes loop per page with fault or IO-needed; enlightened pointer diverts PTRLD/PTRST/CLEAR/READ.
State exports only with feature and region, growing for images with flags; present via current or enlightened pointer; translation needs paging with user fixup; CR4 alias; logs prefix module.

Fixed keeps guest and shadow, reprogramming changes; RDPMC rejects bad versions, allows fixed, bounds and hardens; firmware needs enable; LBR excludes TDX; validity follows windows; resolution prefers fixed, event, counter; release drops inactive.

locks.text: Shadow disables preemption across load, transfer, clear, restore; rare sync and VPID pin CPU, deferring flush when last loaded elsewhere.
LBR MSR access masks local IRQs around active test and hardware read or write.

state_machines.text: EPT fault: PML-full or misconfig exits, else violation with merged qualif, then invalidates and completes; PML writes addr and decrements unless disabled, full or fails; enlightened copies threshold and RIP then groups when clean clear, skipping unsupported and read-only.
Entry tail marks pending, clears deadline, attempts non-root with flush and safe cache, handling halted and startup and failures; enter allocates controls, timer, fresh VPID, unwinds on OOM.

VMX off to on at VMXON and back at VMXOFF; current loads at PTRLD and clears at CLEAR or release with flush and free; restore leaves nesting, validates, records region, copies image, restores run, trap, shadow, deadline and enters non-root.

EPT context frees matches and global frees all; switching reads entry, ignores active, else installs and flushes; VMFUNC advances only on supported with success, else reflects; vmentry is clean, failure-code, failure-exit or host-error.

structs.text: VMCS12 write uses encoding width at offset; logical control has activity, flags, interrupt info, qualif, windows, timer, debug; per-vCPU has pending flags, maps, timer, controls, caches, VPID, vector; INVEPT operand is two u64, plus pointers and flags.

Exchange has header with flags, format, length, regions, deadline, SMM, plus images; RDPMC splits type 31:16 and index 15:0 with general zero and fixed base; full-width is base distance; header has guard.
